title: Keiko Fujimori celebrates election victory as opponent Sánchez alleges fraud
detail: Keiko Fujimori celebrated her victory in Peru's 2026 presidential election as her opponent Roberto Sánchez alleged fraud, raising political tensions following the vote. The dispute intensifies an already contentious post-election period in Peru, where the runoff result has been closely contested.
